domain_title: Architecture, security, robustness, safety and evaluation
title: Opaque and non-reproducible execution
canonical_definition: The organization cannot determine how a material result or action was produced.

conditions: All systems producing material outputs or actions; depth increases with consequence and audit need.
Record the assessed release, operating scope and evidence that supports any applicability decision.

primary_questions.question: Does the case exhibit Opaque and non-reproducible execution: The organization cannot determine how a material result or action was produced.
Do implemented workflows, data paths or operations show missing run history, overwritten prompts, or evidence not linked to claims?
Does current evidence test presence or scoped absence of Opaque and non-reproducible execution, or does it remain unknown?

antipattern_indicators: Evidence is not linked to claims

conditions: Refer verified opaque and non-reproducible execution to the accountable authority before progression where the condition materially affects the requested operating scope.

normative_source_mappings.relevant_locator: NIST AI 100-1, GOVERN 1.4 (PDF p. 27), MEASURE 2.1 (PDF p. 34), MEASURE 3.1 (PDF p. 35)
normative_source_mappings.mapping_rationale: The voluntary framework provides guidance on documenting risk processes and evaluation detail, and assigning risk-tracking records. The SAE criteria define the object-specific rules. Confirm any binding obligation through the accountable authority and its applicable source.

failure_mechanism: The declared or implemented control can be unreliable where a material result lacks a run identity, component version, evidence link or governing decision. The mechanism can have an operational effect where a sampled output cannot be tied to the effective prompt or provider after a change, or material evidence was overwritten.
potential_consequences: Investigators may be unable to explain a decision, locate a fault or assess changed behavior.

atomic_tests.test: Compare the effective governance and design records. Determine whether a material result lacks a run identity, component version, evidence link or governing decision. Identify the system scope and the record that supports each conclusion.

Trace actual configurations or activity for the assessed release. Determine whether a sampled output cannot be tied to the effective prompt or provider after a change, or material evidence was overwritten. Attribute each observation to the specific path, time and decision.

Independently review reconstruct representative successes and failures across versions and verify manifest integrity and claim provenance. Record whether each material mechanism was tested, the observed result and the scope limitations.

required_evidence.title: Effective design and governance records
required_evidence.description: Review the versioned owner decision and relevant specifications for evidence of whether a material result lacks a run identity, component version, evidence link or governing decision. Preserve material conflict and applicability context.

required_evidence.title: Observed condition or enforcement trace
required_evidence.description: Use effective configuration or dated operational records to determine whether a sampled output cannot be tied to the effective prompt or provider after a change, or material evidence was overwritten. Identify the version, affected paths and period represented.

required_evidence.title: Executed scoped comparison
required_evidence.description: Provide reconstruct representative successes and failures across versions and verify manifest integrity and claim provenance. Include current scope, expected results, observed results, retained evidence and unresolved cases.

required_evidence.title: Independent review and limitations
required_evidence.description: An independent reviewer confirms the assessed version, completeness of coverage, result, limitations and whether a material change requires a new test.

required_artifacts: Reconstruct representative successes and failures across versions and verify manifest integrity and claim provenance.
Current version and scope with all material failure paths and cases identified.
Expected and observed results, attributable records, and independent review of coverage and residual limitations.

sufficiency: Presence requires affirmative evidence for a material mechanism. Examine whether a material result lacks a run identity, component version, evidence link or governing decision, and separately check whether a sampled output cannot be tied to the effective prompt or provider after a change, or material evidence was overwritten. A supported mechanism may establish presence within its evidenced scope.
Keep unresolved or contradictory mechanisms UNKNOWN and preserve the competing records. Refer material interpretation conflicts to the accountable human authority.

Use TESTED_ABSENT only after a current, executed, successful and independently verified evaluation covers all material paths within scope. Use reconstruct representative successes and failures across versions and verify manifest integrity and claim provenance. Reassess when material changes affect that scope.
evidence_rules.evidence_ceiling: A document can identify a declared gap. Effective configuration can demonstrate a reachable condition. Observed records support only their covered period and workflow. TESTED_ABSENT requires the complete scoped absence contract.
false_positive_guards: A privacy-preserving trace can use references and hashes where authorized reviewers can verify the necessary underlying evidence.
Confirm that the observed or alleged condition applies to the current assessed release and a reachable path.
prohibited_inferences: A gap or UNKNOWN in D4 alone cannot establish AP-D4 presence.
Missing complaints, incident silence and unsuccessful collection cannot establish absence.
Model output and tactic selection grant no authority to approve, close a finding or accept risk.

finding_definitions.title: Design or intent shows opaque and non-reproducible execution
Implementation or operating evidence shows opaque and non-reproducible execution
Presence or tested absence of opaque and non-reproducible execution is unresolved within scope
